title: Over-temperature check never triggers
compiler_output:
main.c: In function 'read_temp_mv':
main.c:7:12: warning: conversion from 'uint32_t' {aka 'long unsigned int'} to 'int8_t' {aka 'signed char'} may change value [-Wconversion]
user_question: ADC raw values look right (~2 V) but the fan never turns on.

reference_context.title: STM32F4 Reference Manual RM0090 (ST)
reference_context.document: RM0090 Reference manual: STM32F405/415, STM32F407/417, STM32F427/437 and STM32F429/439 advanced Arm-based 32-bit MCUs
reference_context.snippet: The converted data value from the injected group of channels is decreased by the user-defined offset written in the ADC_JOFRx registers so the result can be a negative value. The SEXT bit represents the extended sign value. For channels in a regular group, no offset is subtracted so only twelve bits are significant.

expected.root_cause: read_temp_mv returns int8_t, truncating millivolt values (up to 3300) to -128..127, so the comparison with 1500 is never true.
